The '''''Peacehawk''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After saving the life of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Strayit]] of the ''[[Marshall Awe]]'', [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Zertik Strom/Legends|Zertik Strom]] was promoted to [[Executive officer/Legends|First Officer]] of the ''Peacehawk'', serving under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ulric Tagge/Legends|Ulric Tagge]]. Whilst on the ''Peacehawk'', Strom served Tagge brilliantly and he was eventually promoted to commanding his own patrol fleet guarding [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]].<ref name="VSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Peacehawk'' was first mentioned in the second part of ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', an article released on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]]. The article does not make clear if the ship was active during the [[Rebellion era]] or the [[Rise of the Empire era]] or if Tagge actually captained the vessel or simply commanded it as part of a fleet.
